youtube_description:
If you check your closet, most likely you will find 75% of clothes are made in Bangladesh. Dhaka, the capital of Bangladesh, where most of these clothes are manufactured, have lots of outlet stores where they sell brand name clothes with slight imperfections at ridiculously low prices. These imperfections are hardly noticeable and I could not find anything in those I bought. 

In this episode, I will be visiting a market called Nurjahan Market
( New Market area) where they sell all the brand names you can possibly think of at dirt cheap prices. 

I will mention what I paid on the screen. This is my Day 4 video in Bangladesh. Please subscribe and like.

Ahmed Dawn's travel video.
